currentCanonicalSource.scope: public charging infrastructure for selected CPOs in Belgium

currentSnapshot.note: Current Data Lab progress states first pass completed for all pages exposed by the selected-CPO NAP dataset.

regionalCrossChecks.flanders: Official Vlaamse dataset covers public and semi-public charging points; semi-public remains in TCC because it is accessible to all drivers for a substantial daily window.
regionalCrossChecks.wallonia: Official SPW dataset covers public and semi-public charging points and states AFIR lineage.
regionalCrossChecks.brussels: Brussels Mobility exposes charging-station/concession datasets, but the current TCC BE baseline is the national NAP selected-CPO DATEX II feed rather than relying on the older Brussels-only inventory.

importantLimitation.rule: Do not interpret absence from the current Eco-Movement selected-CPO feed as private/non-public. Missing operators must be addressed through additional AFIR/NAP or operator feeds.
